name: qt-stack-lsp
description: Qt stack support for Claude Code. A QML language server (Qt's own qmlls, found in the project's Qt installation even when it is not on PATH), a PostToolUse hook that checks edited .qml files with qmllint, .ui files with uic and .qrc files with rcc, and a skill that builds compile_commands.json from qmake-generated Makefiles so clangd can resolve Qt and project headers. C++ itself stays with the official clangd-lsp plugin.
